We defined a 21-color flow cytometry panel of mononuclear leukocyte lineage and phenotypic markers ( Table S2 ) to broadly assess the immunological cellular profile of recovered COVID-19 patients ( Figures 1 and S2 ).
We utilized T cell receptor (TCR) dependent activation induced marker (AIM) assays to identify and quantify SARS-CoV-2-specific CD4 + T cells in recovered COVID-19 patients.
To measure SARS-CoV-2-specific CD8 + T cells in the recovered COVID-19 patients, we utilized two complementary methodologies, AIM assays and intracellular cytokine staining (ICS).
An in-house ELISA at UNC was performed by coating with recombinant S RBD antigens (SARS-CoV-2, SARS-CoV, OC43-CoV and NL63-CoV) in TBS for 1 h at 37 C.
